# Problem 0
``` {r load_libraries, message = F}
library(tidyverse)
```


# Problem 1

``` {r load_penguins, message = F}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
penguins
``` 

The `palmerpenguin` dataset `penguins` presents a list of `r nrow(penguins)` penguins that are categorized by `species`, `island`, `bill_length_mm`, `bill_depth_mm`, `flipper_length_mm`, `body_mass_ (grams)_g`, `sex` and `year`. The dataset contains `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns. The penguin's mean flipper length is `r mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)`.

``` {r penguins_problems, message = F}
scatterplot_penguins = ggplot(
  data = penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) + geom_point()

scatterplot_penguins 

ggsave("scatterplot_penguins.pdf", height = 4, width = 6)
```
